title: Use the configurator's tool versions
author: claude
summary: The lab uses the same versions as the configurator, so code can move back without surprises.
what: We checked the configurator's package list and used the same versions of the main tools in the lab.
why: Code written in the lab should work in the configurator as it is.
how: The exact versions are listed under settings below.

tech.name: three.js
tech.plain: Draws 3D scenes in the web browser.

tech.name: React Three Fiber
tech.plain: Lets us describe a three.js scene with React building blocks.

tech.name: React
tech.plain: The toolkit that builds the lab and dev log pages from small parts.

tech.name: Vite
tech.plain: Runs the lab in the browser while we work and builds it for release.

tech.name: TypeScript
tech.plain: A stricter form of JavaScript that catches mistakes before the code runs.
